hypothesis: One persistent explorable product model reduces manual reconciliation across intent, code, contracts and evidence while preserving explainability.
baseline_candidates: SCIP/LSP search plus a dependency explorer
scenario: Import three representative owned products with seeded and retained-real gaps: an unreachable public capability, stale coverage evidence, a changed dependency, a duplicated owner and a legitimate exception. Ask an unfamiliar operator to explain current behavior, locate the issue, identify affected consumers and plan a bounded repair. Repeat after a source change and restart.
failure_cases: Stale revision is presented as current
Unsupported dynamic edge is asserted as proven
Untrusted repository prose becomes a command
Private evidence leaks into a public projection
metrics: Correctness and precision/recall on adjudicated gap cases
Time and interactions to an evidence-backed explanation
Incremental update latency and stale-result exposure
